purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Form 34B final TOTAL row for the Atlas's constituency code 251 (canonically named 'Mbita' in this Atlas), read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 250 DPI directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (PyMuPDF render of the same source file; no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (content-disposition filename F34B-043-251-0000-000-00.PDF, matching county 043 / constituency 251), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. The live forms.iebc.or.ke portal now defaults to serving 2022-2027 by-election data and returns HTTP 500 for 2022 general-election form ids unless the session's election context is first switched to 'r=common/set-election&id=5' (2022 General Elections); once switched, this same form id serves the identical, correctly identified 2022 general-election Form 34B. NAMING DISCREPANCY FLAGGED FOR TRANSPARENCY: the printed form's own header field 'Name of Constituency' reads 'SUBA NORTH' (County: HOMA BAY, Code: 043) for this same constituency code 251, not 'Mbita'. This Atlas's own geography registry (data/geography/registry/geographies.json) independently lists constituency_code 251 in county 043 under the name 'Mbita' (geo_code KEN-C043-CON251), which appears to be a stale/pre-2012-delimitation name retained in the registry rather than a code or boundary mismatch: the numeric constituency_code (251), county code (043), and the independently-computed ward-derived registered-voter denominator all match this printed form exactly, so this is understood to be a display-name discrepancy in the Atlas's own taxonomy, not a wrong-form or wrong-geography download. This is recorded here rather than silently corrected; the Atlas's constituency/geography naming for codes 251 (and likely 252) may warrant a separate governed naming-taxonomy review outside the scope of this turnout tranche. No special/national voting-station rows (e.g. prison or diaspora facility codes) are present in this constituency's polling-station list, so the printed TOTAL reconciles exactly to the canonical ward-derived registered-voter denominator with no adjustment required.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.
